items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was almost like Tommy Turk. He was a very good player; he was way ahead of his time.

ctx.x: Hearing him on the plane with that band. He heard me playing in the music room when he came in there to check the guys out. He said, “Could you handle it if I call you up to play tonight?” I said, “I’ll try it.” Of course, the school kids where I went said, “Oh god, no, not that guy. Get him out of here, we played for the band.” You know, that’s where I got this movement from (scats a melody). He was almost like Tommy Turk. He was a very good player; he was way ahead of his time. He was playing more musically…
Now we are talking Detroit trombone players.
